text_block_list.text:
"Following their inspection of the BC, 
'DREAMS' decided to implement various 
measures in order to claim victory against 
powerhouse nations."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—What we need is precise information 
analysis and counterstrategies.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Why are those nations so strong? Let us 
organize our thoughts on that point.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well, the biggest factor is probably the 
player base. Sheer numbers are simply an 
advantage!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The competitive player base in 
Europe and America is nearly double that 
of Japan— a massive foundation built for 
producing geniuses.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Also, the system for developing 
successors. In the West, more people enter 
the path of coaching at a relatively 
earlier stage than in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Beyond just the option to keep competing 
for a long time, having a system where 
talented individuals can become 
instructors early on if they wish is 
precisely what supports the training of so 
many next-generation athletes.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However, since this also involves the 
institutional design of the racing world, 
it's not something that can be achieved 
overnight.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...However, can the West really afford 
sufficient development costs for all those 
many athlete candidates? I mean... like 
human resources and facilities."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: "That's right. Good eye, Desire."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Even if the base of the mountain is broad, 
not many get to train in top-tier 
environments.
choice_data_list:
You're right. And that is precisely the 
key to victory.

Yeah. And that right there is the key to 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Tracen Academy is already full of 
handpicked Umamusume, so we simply need to 
concentrate our resources here.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In other words, "imposing great trials 
upon the chosen ones"... ...is what this 
means, right...?!
choice_data_list:
W-Well, I guess it's something like 
that...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
For an Umamusume taking on the challenge 
alone, every resource—people, equipment, 
funds—is strictly limited, after all.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"However, now it's different. Having 
proven yourself domestically, earning the 
recognition that makes everyone believe 
'she has a real shot at the BC'—"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"You made the URA believe that achieving 
their long-cherished dream of a BC victory 
was worth betting on. That is precisely 
why we can now implement targeted measures 
with focused resources."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"...So, there are two key countermeasures. 
The first is—"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: A simulated battle using VR.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
That simulators are effective for getting 
used to real combat is common knowledge in 
aviation and car racing too, right?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the Academy has the VR Umulator. 
It'd be a waste not to use that tool, 
right?

Yes, the Academy has 
ultra-high-performance VR machines. 
Depending on the software, they can 
meticulously replicate race environments 
and function as full simulators.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
It's a full-dive type equipped with 
sensory feedback. Conditions, as well as 
the virtual opponent's stats and behavior, 
are adjustable. I'll be taking priority 
use of this until the main event.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"However, a mock battle is still just a 
mock battle. Understanding it in your head 
and having your body adapt to it are two 
different things, you know~"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So it's not entirely all-powerful, is what 
you're saying?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪ It's super effective, but it has its 
limits. So here's our second measure.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is the centerpiece of "the 
resource investment we couldn't do back 
during the solo challenge era," but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Load-in, commence!
All right, keep it comin'!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that... dirt? Spreading dirt over 
part of the grounds...?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Its quality is as close to the dirt 
over there as humanly possible. Things 
like the friction coefficient and all are 
practically identical.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well, even if making a whole lap is 
impossible, that should be enough to get 
our bodies used to it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
To think you even repurposed expertise 
from the civil engineering field for this. 
I'd call it utterly audacious. Quite an 
achievement to pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ But honestly, we only managed to 
pull it off thanks to Casino-san and the 
Chairwoman, right?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"The abilities of each member and their 
domestic track records speak for 
themselves, as I'm sure you all agree."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This roster is a "winning" roster! 
And this plan of mine is designed to bring 
out their full potential at the BC!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This is precisely where an investment is 
needed! That is, if the URA truly desires 
victory in the BC!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, the URA has decided to provide full 
financial support for the training 
facility enhancement plan. From here on, 
speed is of the essence, such as 
establishing a swift construction 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Wahahaha! I've made no oversights on that 
front! We're holding an extraordinary 
board meeting right away."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You have splendidly won the URA's support. 
I promise I will not keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This is the support we could never have 
received going at it alone. Proof that our 
dream in 'DREAMS' is recognized as worth 
investing in.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Safety first! Are your surroundings and 
footing clear?!

text_block_list.name: Construction Workers
text_block_list.text: All clear, check complete!!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...This is on a scale unlike 
anything before... but, How exciting. It 
really gets my heart racing.

With the upgraded facilities, it became 
possible to improve abilities in an ideal 
environment. And one more thing—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Doooooryaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...A track made to recreate BC dirt... It 
sure is tough.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Even with the cornering technique I 
learned, if I don't adjust how I exert 
power, I'll flare out or stall... Dammit.

text_block_list.name: VR System Voice
text_block_list.text:
“—Result: 3rd place. This concludes the 
simulation program.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Even in a simulation, world-class is 
still world-class. I can't find an opening 
to break through.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to this, experience is 
everything, you know~"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: I have an announcement for everyone.

While the facilities were ready, I felt 
there was room for improvement regarding 
the training curriculum. And after 
consulting with Casino Drive—
choice_data_list:
I'm thinking of bringing in a specialized 
support coach.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Support coach...?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The current coaching regimen was 
designed by me, but even I cannot claim to 
be an "expert" in every single skill.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Then I shall have an "expert" from within 
the academy share their know-how with me."
choice_data_list:
To everyone on the team, and to Uma Musume 
outside the team if needed

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪ I'm gonna blast off at top speed~.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Unprecedented" speed and explosive power. 
For technical guidance in sprints, miles, 
and front-running strategies, we have 
Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the know-how of short, 
decisive battles, there's plenty you can 
learn from her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"She" is trying to convey something. ...In 
order to conquer the world.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Possessing high-level speed and stamina, 
Cafe-san specializes in late-spurt duels 
at medium to long distances.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Her use of her legs from the middle to 
late stages in particular, as well as her 
pacing up to that point, should serve as a 
good reference.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ Having El as your support coach was 
totally the right choice, *deeesu*!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Distance and track conditions don't matter 
at all; El is an all-rounder who's 
expert-grade in everything.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
There is much to learn from her ability to 
adapt freely to the strength and running 
styles of her opponents.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Under any conditions— the Mission must be 
completed.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san, who always delivers peak 
performance regardless of the 
circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
You need the raw power to power through 
grueling race developments so you don't 
get outmatched at the critical moment, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
With these four serving as support 
coaches, we aim to share techniques and 
knowledge even more deeply!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... What kind of acceleration was 
that?! Did she pack a car engine in there 
or something...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪ I've still totally got it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's fire up for one more lap! 
Full power, GO GO♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, dammit...! Like hell I'm gonna lose, 
get back here, hey!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"She"... is speaking. Saying she will 
"teach you how to fight."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And... "rewrite" the future of Twinkle 
Series racing.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! To think I'd get to learn 
Café-san's running style with one-on-one 
instruction...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I beg of you...! Grant me that noble light 
to illuminate the whole wide world!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...First, let's calm down with some 
coffee. You have a tendency to push 
yourself too hard."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"We will teach you how to wield that 
late-stretch kick. So—show us. Show us you 
reaching 'that distant realm.'"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Nothing is impossible for a 
saintess to begin with! I will live up to 
your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Voice
text_block_list.text:
The chance lasts—only for a split second. 
One needs the eyes—to never miss an 
opening.

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Voice
text_block_list.text:
"The difficulty at the BC is――Rank SSS. 
Understand that this is a harsh Mission."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Even so—what I want to do lies just beyond 
this.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of Love-chan's dream too... 
Please!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Mission acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Special training—will now commence.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
As expected of an all-rounder. You 
skillfully adapt your strategy based on 
the competition.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. The Condor catches the wind and 
flies higher and higher, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Having so many approaches is super hype. I 
just gotta get my hands on that know-how☆

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mambo's cheering me on too! I'm going 
straight for the championship, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"By establishing a new dual-engine 
framework combining hardware and software, 
our preparations for the real BC race are 
rapidly gaining precision..."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Reaching our target line by summer should 
by no means be an overly optimistic view.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... To think that English training 
would stand as a trial before me before I 
could even learn the language of "that 
land"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Conditioning both body and mind becomes 
more crucial the longer we stay. Falling 
ill before a crucial race... We must take 
measures against that risk.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah~. Bad mental shape can lead to 
injuries too. Keeping up the hype is super 
important, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged! I shall see to it that there 
are no concerns regarding the medical 
staff!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"...To think everyone would help out with 
things outside of training too... Hehe."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
A support system that was never built back 
in the era of myself and those who took on 
the challenge alone. "DREAMS" is the first 
to make it a reality.
choice_data_list:
I guess it means more people have come to 
share the same dream.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Dreaming on one's own is fine as 
well, but... the BC is also a "festival."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
If it's a dream born of this "festival"... 
the more, the merrier. That's what I 
think.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
After all, "DREAMS" will become the 
crystallization of everyone's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That's right.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Let us build a team that will surely 
win.
